subject: Kickoff: Joint MAP & evaluation charter — confirm scope, timeline, and decision owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@helixbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Joint MAP & evaluation charter — confirm scope, timeline, and decision owners

Hi Emily — great to meet you on the call yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to take the lead on getting a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and evaluation charter in place so we have a single source of truth for scope, timelines, and who’s responsible for each milestone.

Attached is a first pass (mutual_action_plan-v1.xlsx) — it’s intentionally light: goals, success criteria, milestones (pilot setup, test corpus, eval pass/fail gates), roles, and three-week target timeline to pilot. High-level asks:
- Could you confirm the primary champion (we noted you) and the legal/procurement and security contacts who need to be engaged?
- Are the pilot success criteria listed (accuracy on curated set, latency SLOs, and cost budget) aligned with Helix’s priorities?
- Any regulatory or data residency constraints we should add to the plan?

Proposed next step: 45-min MAP kickoff this week to align owners and lock the timeline. I’ve included a short proposed agenda in the attachments. Availability on my side: Thu 9/9 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 9/10 13:00–13:45 PT. If those don’t work, send a couple slots and we’ll accommodate.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (CSM) who will support onboarding and Stephanie (Sales Manager) who will be looping in procurement and escalation points.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the plan in motion.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: mutual_action_plan-v1.xlsx; proposed-kickoff-agenda.docx; redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

---
(For internal tracking) HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/HB-2026-045

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@helixbio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@helixbio.com>, Security Ops <security.ops@helixbio.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Joint MAP & evaluation charter — confirm scope, timeline, and decision owners

Karthik — thanks for the note and the draft MAP. I reviewed quickly with my team and this looks like a good starting point. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- Confirming I will be the project champion.
- Procurement (procurement@helixbio.com) needs to be in the loop for the SOW and any PO / terms discussion — I’ve cc’d them.
- Security would like a short SOC2 + data handling summary before we start ingesting test data; I’ve looped Security Ops here.

On timing: we’re constrained the week of 9/13 for stakeholder availability (several folks at a conference). Can we target 9/15 or 9/17 for the kickoff? Either afternoon PT would work for us.

Also quick note on success criteria: please add a lightweight rubric for the evaluation (e.g., quant metric thresholds + qualitative review steps). That helps accelerate internal approvals.

Happy to meet and walk through the MAP with your team.

Best,
Emily Zhang
Director, AI Platforms | Helix Bio
emily.zhang@helixbio.com

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Joint MAP & evaluation charter — confirm scope, timeline, and decision owners

Hi Emily — thanks for confirming you’ll champion this. I’ll own onboarding logistics and the evaluation cadence. I updated the attached MAP with an initial rubric section (pass/fail thresholds, sample distribution expectations) and a short compliance checklist for the security asks. Please see "mutual_action_plan-v1.xlsx" (updated).

Proposed 45-min kickoff agenda (suggested):
1) Introductions + roles (5 min)
2) Proposed pilot scope and dataset description (10 min)
3) Evaluation rubric and acceptance criteria (10 min)
4) Compliance/security asks and evidence needed (10 min)
5) Next steps, owners, and dates (10 min)

Emily — you mentioned 9/15 or 9/17 afternoons PT. We can do 9/15 1:00–1:45 PM PT or 9/17 2:30–3:15 PM PT — which works best? Also, please confirm the procurement and security contacts who will join or provide pre-read materials.

Thanks — I’ll also add a short shared Drive folder with the MAP and SOW draft (link below) so procurement/security can access redwood’s SOC2 summary.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0188

Emily — thanks for the fast turnaround and the suggested timing. 9/15 1:00–1:45 PM PT works for us; I’ve sent a calendar invite to the group and added the proposed agenda.

Actions before kickoff (owners):
- Karthik: finalize MAP v1 and add initial tokenized eval examples (attached).
- Marissa: share SOC2 summary and onboarding checklist with Security Ops and Procurement (done — redwood-soc2-summary.pdf attached).
- Emily: confirm procurement attendee and whether a legal reviewer will join the kickoff.

I’ve also uploaded the SOW initial draft to the Drive and created a DocuSign envelope for signature when procurement and legal are ready: signature-request-docusign.url

See you 9/15 — calendar invite includes Zoom and Drive links.

Best,
